Your agent has two user-defined tools, and Claude keeps calling the wrong one.
You want a CI review job in which any tool call you have not pre-approved is refused, not left waiting.
An invoice pipeline reads records from a non-strict extraction tool.
A support bot built on the Messages API sends the system prompt, its tool definitions and the customer's newest message on each request.
A customer support resolution agent built with the Claude Agent SDK reaches backend systems through custom MCP tools (get_customer, lookup_order, process_refund, escalate_to_human).
In production, the agent occasionally calls the wrong tool and sometimes misses tool calls entirely.
Define tools 문서가 도구 성능에 "단연 가장 중요한 요소"로 꼽는 것은?
A newly onboarded architect asks Claude Code to trace how a login request flows from the HTTP route handler through to the database call, in a codebase Claude has not explored yet.
They don't yet know how cache invalidation, conflicting edits or clients dropping mid-edit should be handled.
It consistently rates its own output clean, yet human reviewers keep finding real bugs it missed.
The engineer has not yet read or edited any files in the `services/billing/reports/` subdirectory.
The review almost never finds problems, yet audits show 20% of the generated tests have weak or tautological assertions.
